\begin{abstract}
Comprehensive evaluation of 12 methods across 5 datasets with multiple metrics.
\end{abstract}

\section{Datasets}

We evaluate on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet, SVHN, and STL-10.

\section{Analysis}

Table~\ref{tab:main} shows ViT-L/16 achieves the best accuracy across all benchmarks.
Table~\ref{tab:cost} reveals the computational cost: ViT-L/16 requires
48 GPU-hours for training vs.\ 2.4 for ResNet-18.
Table~\ref{tab:f1} confirms the F1 trend mirrors accuracy.
Table~\ref{tab:robust} demonstrates that vision transformers are more robust
to input corruptions, with ViT-L/16 leading by $+6.4$ points over ResNet-50.
Tables~\ref{tab:transfer} and~\ref{tab:ablation} show transfer learning and
data augmentation results, respectively.

\section{Conclusion}

ViT-L/16 dominates all metrics but at $10\times$ the compute cost of EfficientNet-B0.
EfficientNet-B3 offers the best accuracy-to-cost tradeoff.
